An '''anti-vehicle mine''', also called a '''vehicle mine''' or '''anti-vehicular mine''' was a type of [[Mine/Legends|mine]] solely intended to target vehicles of multiple classes. Each mine was embedded with microcircuitry which allowed the weapon to differentiate between vehicles and organic creatures.<ref name="CCG-ls" /> Once the mine detected either a metallic mass or a [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] field, the mine would detonate and explode.<ref name="CCG-ds" /> Each mine generally cost 750 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to purchase.<ref name="SWS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Anti-vehicular mines appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
